title: 4v4 Transition Both Ways
description: A full-court 4v4 where every made basket or defensive stop immediately triggers a fast break the other way, keeping both ends live.

content.objective: Play continuous, both-way basketball where every change of possession becomes a transition opportunity.
content.setup: Two teams of four play full-court, with transition offense and defense live at both ends.
instructions: Play live full-court 4v4 to a target score.
On any change of possession, the new offense should push the ball immediately.
The new defense sprints back to protect the rim before matching up.
Play continuous periods of several minutes with brief rest between.
coachingPoints: Push the pace immediately on every change of possession.
Sprint back on defense rather than jogging and conceding easy transition points.
Communicate matchups loudly while sprinting back.
commonMistakes: Walking the ball up instead of pushing the pace after a stop.
Jogging back on defense and conceding an easy transition basket.
Playing at a walk-through pace instead of real game speed.
content.safety: Make sure the full court is clear and players are conditioned enough for continuous full-court play.
